name: MonarchSectionCard
title: SectionCard
wrapsNative: VStack on the MonarchCard surface with the MonarchSectionHeader type, MonarchLoadingState, MonarchEmptyState and MonarchErrorState, and a Button for the collapsible title
summary: A titled card for one section of a screen or dashboard: a header with actions, the content, an optional footer bar, and built-in loading, empty and error states. Optionally collapsible.
whenToUse: For a section of a dashboard or settings screen that loads on its own, such as recent invoices or team members.
whenNotToUse: For a plain surface without a title or states, use MonarchCard. For a section of a grouped List or Form, use Section with a header.

options.name: meta
options.description: A short secondary line: a count, a date range.

options.name: systemImage
options.description: An SF Symbol before the title.

options.name: tone
options.description: danger for a destructive zone: border, title and an icon in the tone. Other tones work the same way.

options.name: state
options.description: What the body shows: content, skeleton rows, empty state or error state.

options.name: emptyMessage
options.description: The message of the empty state.

options.name: errorMessage
options.description: The message of the error state.

options.name: isBusy
options.description: Refreshing in place: a progress indicator after the title while the content stays.

options.name: isRetrying
options.description: The error state's retry is running.

options.name: isFlush
options.description: No body padding, for a list that runs to the edges.

options.name: isCollapsible
options.description: The title shows and hides the body and footer.

options.name: isInitiallyExpanded
options.description: Whether a collapsible card starts open.

options.name: labels
options.description: Replacements for Loading, the empty and error titles, Expanded, Collapsed and the tone name.

options.name: onRetry
options.description: Shows a retry button in the error state.

options.name: actions
options.description: Buttons or a menu at the trailing edge of the header.

states.name: loading
states.description: Three skeleton rows from MonarchLoadingState; the title reads Loading as its value.

states.name: empty
states.description: A small MonarchEmptyState with Nothing here yet and the empty message.

states.name: error
states.description: A small MonarchErrorState with This section didn’t load, the error message and a retry.

states.name: busy
states.description: A progress indicator after the title; the content stays.

states.name: collapsed
states.description: Only the header; the chevron points down. Expanded, it points up.

states.name: tone
states.description: A tone other than neutral colours the border and title and adds the tone's icon.

appearance: The surface fill, subtle border, large radius and padding of MonarchCard, with the extra-small shadow. The footer bar has the subtle background and a rule above it. The title uses the section header's medium title style; description and meta are muted.
platformNotes: The parity map names MonarchCard with header and footer slots. MonarchCard pads its content evenly and has no footer, so the section card draws the same surface from MonarchCardTokens to support flush bodies and a footer bar. The web takes a custom empty node; on iOS keep state ready and put a MonarchEmptyState with actions in the content. The web's link slot is the actions slot, and the web's headingLevel has no iOS equivalent (the title has the header trait). The web's controlled open prop is not offered; the card keeps its own open state.
accessibility: The title has the header trait and is one element with its description and meta.
A collapsible title is a button with a 44-point touch target; its value is Expanded or Collapsed.
While loading or busy the title's value adds Loading and the progress indicator is hidden.
A tone other than neutral adds the tone's icon, read as the tone's name.
Actions stay separate elements and move under the title at the accessibility text sizes.
edgeCases: In the loading, empty and error states the content is not shown.
A collapsed card hides the footer as well.
Long titles wrap; actions keep their size.
The loading state announces itself when it appears, through MonarchLoadingState.
